title: 橋梁氣動穩定風洞試驗
subcategoryTitle: 橋梁耐久、檢測與健康監測
subcategoryTitleEn: Bridge durability, inspection and health monitoring
summary: 從 1940 年塔科馬海峽橋的扭轉顫振崩塌出發，建立橋面設計風速、氣動現象分類、斷面外形與扭轉勁度、Scruton 數等結構參數，再處理施工懸臂階段的抗風、節段模型的彈簧懸吊試驗與縮尺換算、全橋氣動彈性模型、營運期渦振與阻尼器改善以及改裝前的風洞複核，並以明石海峽大橋的全橋模型風洞試驗與伏爾加格勒大橋 2010 年振動事件為例。
summaryEn: Starting from the torsional flutter collapse of the Tacoma Narrows Bridge in 1940, establish deck design wind speed, the classes of aeroelastic phenomena, section shape and torsional stiffness and structural parameters such as the Scruton number, then cover wind resistance during cantilever erection, spring-mounted section-model tests and scaling, full aeroelastic models, in-service vortex vibration and damper retrofits and aerodynamic rechecks before modifications, using the full-model wind-tunnel tests of the Akashi Kaikyō Bridge and the 2010 vibration event on the Volgograd Bridge.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「設計風速與風場特性」與「渦振、馳振、顫振與抖振」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Design wind speed and wind-field characteristics" and "Vortex shedding, galloping, flutter and buffeting": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 設計風速與風場特性：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Design wind speed and wind-field characteristics: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「橋面高度設計風速」如何影響橋梁氣動穩定風洞試驗的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Deck-level design wind speed” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge aerodynamic stability wind-tunnel testing”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 風洞試驗的第一步是決定要對哪個風速做檢核：基本風速通常以地面上 10 m 高、某回歸期的 10 分鐘平均風速表示，再依地況粗糙度以冪次律或對數律換算到橋面與塔頂高度。海峽與河口地形開闊、粗糙度低，風速隨高度增加較慢但基本值高；山谷地形則可能產生局部加速與強烈紊流。除平均風速外，還要給出紊流強度與積分尺度，因為它們決定了陣風抖振的大小，也影響模型試驗中紊流場的重現。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「橋面高度設計風速」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The first step in wind-tunnel work is deciding which wind speed to check against: the basic wind speed is usually a 10-minute mean at 10 m above ground for a given return period, converted to deck and tower-top height with a power or logarithmic law according to terrain roughness. Open straits and estuaries have low roughness, so speed grows slowly with height but the base value is high; valleys can produce local speed-up and strong turbulence. Besides mean speed, turbulence intensity and integral length scales must be specified, because they control buffeting response and must be reproduced in model tests. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Deck-level design wind speed” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：冪次律 U(z) = U₁₀·(z/10)^α。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Power law U(z) = U₁₀·(z/10)^α.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「橋梁設計風速直接採用當地氣象站的最大紀錄即可。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A bridge's design wind speed can simply be the local weather station's highest record." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「橋面高度設計風速」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Deck-level design wind speed”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 設計風速與風場特性
knowledge.titleEn: Design wind speed and wind-field characteristics
knowledge.text: 風洞試驗的第一步是決定要對哪個風速做檢核：基本風速通常以地面上 10 m 高、某回歸期的 10 分鐘平均風速表示，再依地況粗糙度以冪次律或對數律換算到橋面與塔頂高度。海峽與河口地形開闊、粗糙度低，風速隨高度增加較慢但基本值高；山谷地形則可能產生局部加速與強烈紊流。
knowledge.textEn: The first step in wind-tunnel work is deciding which wind speed to check against: the basic wind speed is usually a 10-minute mean at 10 m above ground for a given return period, converted to deck and tower-top height with a power or logarithmic law according to terrain roughness. Open straits and estuaries have low roughness, so speed grows slowly with height but the base value is high; valleys can produce local speed-up and strong turbulence.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：橋梁設計風速直接採用當地氣象站的最大紀錄即可。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A bridge's design wind speed can simply be the local weather station's highest record. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「設計風速與風場特性」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Design wind speed and wind-field characteristics" is correct?
options: 橋梁設計風速直接採用當地氣象站的最大紀錄即可。
風洞試驗的第一步是決定要對哪個風速做檢核：基本風速通常以地面上 10 m 高、某回歸期的 10 分鐘平均風速表示，再依地況粗糙度以冪次律或對數律換算到橋面與塔頂高度。
只要橋梁能承受最大風速的靜風壓，就不會因風而破壞。
optionsEn: A bridge's design wind speed can simply be the local weather station's highest record.

The first step in wind-tunnel work is deciding which wind speed to check against: the basic wind speed is usually a 10-minute mean at 10 m above ground for a given return period, converted to deck and tower-top height with a power or logarithmic law according to terrain roughness.
If a bridge withstands the static pressure of the maximum wind, wind cannot destroy it.
quiz.explanation: 風洞試驗的第一步是決定要對哪個風速做檢核：基本風速通常以地面上 10 m 高、某回歸期的 10 分鐘平均風速表示，再依地況粗糙度以冪次律或對數律換算到橋面與塔頂高度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The first step in wind-tunnel work is deciding which wind speed to check against: the basic wind speed is usually a 10-minute mean at 10 m above ground for a given return period, converted to deck and tower-top height with a power or logarithmic law according to terrain roughness. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 設計風速與風場特性：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Design wind speed and wind-field characteristics: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「橋面高度設計風速」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Deck-level design wind speed” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：冪次律 U(z) = U₁₀·(z/10)^α。若基本風速 46 m/s、橋面高約 97 m、取 α = 1/8（教學假設），U = 46×9.7^0.125 ≈ 61 m/s，與明石海峽大橋公開的加勁梁設計風速 60 m/s 相近；若 α 改為 1/6，同高度風速約 67 m/s。數值除註明者外為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Power law U(z) = U₁₀·(z/10)^α. With a basic wind speed of 46 m/s, a deck about 97 m above the sea and α = 1/8 as a teaching assumption, U = 46×9.7^0.125 ≈ 61 m/s, close to the published 60 m/s girder design wind speed of the Akashi Kaikyō Bridge; with α = 1/6 the speed at the same height is about 67 m/s. Values other than those cited are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比對規範風速圖、鄰近氣象站與現地測風塔的長期紀錄，以極值統計得到回歸期風速；地形複雜的橋址以地形模型風洞試驗或數值模擬確認風速剖面、風向與紊流強度，再作為節段與全橋試驗的輸入。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare code wind maps with long records from nearby weather stations and a site mast, derive return-period speeds by extreme-value statistics, and for complex terrain confirm profiles, directions and turbulence by topographic model tests or numerical simulation before using them as inputs to section and full-bridge tests.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 冪次律 U(z) = U₁₀·(z/10)^α。若基本風速 46 m/s、橋面高約 97 m、取 α = 1/8（教學假設），U = 46×9.7^0.125 ≈ 61 m/s，與明石海峽大橋公開的加勁梁設計風速 60 m/s 相近；若 α 改為 1/6，同高度風速約 67 m/s。數值除註明者外為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Power law U(z) = U₁₀·(z/10)^α. With a basic wind speed of 46 m/s, a deck about 97 m above the sea and α = 1/8 as a teaching assumption, U = 46×9.7^0.125 ≈ 61 m/s, close to the published 60 m/s girder design wind speed of the Akashi Kaikyō Bridge; with α = 1/6 the speed at the same height is about 67 m/s. Values other than those cited are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「設計風速與風場特性」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Design wind speed and wind-field characteristics", which statement holds?
options: 結構阻尼對風振影響很小，試驗時隨便取一個值即可。
懸臂施工只要吊車能吊得動，風速大小不影響安全。
冪次律 U(z) = U₁₀·(z/10)^α。
optionsEn: Structural damping barely affects wind response, so any value will do in tests.
As long as the crane can lift the segment, wind speed does not affect cantilever safety.
Power law U(z) = U₁₀·(z/10)^α.
quiz.explanation: 冪次律 U(z) = U₁₀·(z/10)^α。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Power law U(z) = U₁₀·(z/10)^α. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 設計風速與風場特性：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Design wind speed and wind-field characteristics: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「橋面高度設計風速」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Deck-level design wind speed” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比對規範風速圖、鄰近氣象站與現地測風塔的長期紀錄，以極值統計得到回歸期風速；地形複雜的橋址以地形模型風洞試驗或數值模擬確認風速剖面、風向與紊流強度，再作為節段與全橋試驗的輸入。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare code wind maps with long records from nearby weather stations and a site mast, derive return-period speeds by extreme-value statistics, and for complex terrain confirm profiles, directions and turbulence by topographic model tests or numerical simulation before using them as inputs to section and full-bridge tests. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：風工程報告的第一章要列出基本風速、回歸期、地況分類、橋面與塔頂設計風速、紊流強度與積分尺度，並說明資料來源；後續所有試驗與分析都引用同一組參數，變更時須全面更新。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The first chapter of the wind-engineering report lists basic speed, return period, terrain category, deck and tower-top design speeds, turbulence intensity and integral scales with their sources; every later test and analysis cites the same set, and any change triggers a full update.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以內陸平坦地況的粗糙度換算海峽橋址的風速，或忽略山谷的局部加速，設計風速被低估，風洞試驗即使通過也只是對錯誤的目標合格；紊流參數錯誤則讓抖振反應與疲勞評估失真。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Converting speeds for a strait site with inland roughness, or ignoring valley speed-up, underestimates design wind speed so a passed wind-tunnel test merely meets the wrong target; wrong turbulence parameters distort buffeting response and fatigue assessment. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比對規範風速圖、鄰近氣象站與現地測風塔的長期紀錄，以極值統計得到回歸期風速；地形複雜的橋址以地形模型風洞試驗或數值模擬確認風速剖面、風向與紊流強度，再作為節段與全橋試驗的輸入。
knowledge.textEn: Compare code wind maps with long records from nearby weather stations and a site mast, derive return-period speeds by extreme-value statistics, and for complex terrain confirm profiles, directions and turbulence by topographic model tests or numerical simulation before using them as inputs to section and full-bridge tests.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 風工程報告的第一章要列出基本風速、回歸期、地況分類、橋面與塔頂設計風速、紊流強度與積分尺度，並說明資料來源；後續所有試驗與分析都引用同一組參數，變更時須全面更新。
knowledge.textEn: The first chapter of the wind-engineering report lists basic speed, return period, terrain category, deck and tower-top design speeds, turbulence intensity and integral scales with their sources; every later test and analysis cites the same set, and any change triggers a full update.

quiz.question: 要驗證「設計風速與風場特性」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Design wind speed and wind-field characteristics"?
options: 比對規範風速圖、鄰近氣象站與現地測風塔的長期紀錄，以極值統計得到回歸期風速。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
節段模型試驗合格，就代表整座長跨橋梁在所有風向下都安全。
optionsEn: Compare code wind maps with long records from nearby weather stations and a site mast, derive return-period speeds by extreme-value statistics, and for complex terrain confirm profiles, directions and turbulence by topographic model tests or numerical simulation before using them as inputs to section and full-bridge tests.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
If the section model passes, the whole long-span bridge is safe in every wind direction.
quiz.explanation: 比對規範風速圖、鄰近氣象站與現地測風塔的長期紀錄，以極值統計得到回歸期風速；地形複雜的橋址以地形模型風洞試驗或數值模擬確認風速剖面、風向與紊流強度，再作為節段與全橋試驗的輸入。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare code wind maps with long records from nearby weather stations and a site mast, derive return-period speeds by extreme-value statistics, and for complex terrain confirm profiles, directions and turbulence by topographic model tests or numerical simulation before using them as inputs to section and full-bridge tests. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 設計風速與風場特性：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Design wind speed and wind-field characteristics: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「橋面高度設計風速」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Deck-level design wind speed” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以內陸平坦地況的粗糙度換算海峽橋址的風速，或忽略山谷的局部加速，設計風速被低估，風洞試驗即使通過也只是對錯誤的目標合格；紊流參數錯誤則讓抖振反應與疲勞評估失真。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Converting speeds for a strait site with inland roughness, or ignoring valley speed-up, underestimates design wind speed so a passed wind-tunnel test merely meets the wrong target; wrong turbulence parameters distort buffeting response and fatigue assessment. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：除平均風速外，還要給出紊流強度與積分尺度，因為它們決定了陣風抖振的大小，也影響模型試驗中紊流場的重現。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Besides mean speed, turbulence intensity and integral length scales must be specified, because they control buffeting response and must be reproduced in model tests.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「橋梁設計風速直接採用當地氣象站的最大紀錄即可。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A bridge's design wind speed can simply be the local weather station's highest record." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 以內陸平坦地況的粗糙度換算海峽橋址的風速，或忽略山谷的局部加速，設計風速被低估，風洞試驗即使通過也只是對錯誤的目標合格；紊流參數錯誤則讓抖振反應與疲勞評估失真。
knowledge.textEn: Converting speeds for a strait site with inland roughness, or ignoring valley speed-up, underestimates design wind speed so a passed wind-tunnel test merely meets the wrong target; wrong turbulence parameters distort buffeting response and fatigue assessment.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

steps.title: 渦振、馳振、顫振與抖振：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Vortex shedding, galloping, flutter and buffeting: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「渦振臨界風速 U_cr」如何影響橋梁氣動穩定風洞試驗的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Vortex-shedding onset speed U_cr” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge aerodynamic stability wind-tunnel testing”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 風對長跨橋面造成四類動力問題：渦流脫落在特定風速鎖定結構頻率，引起有限振幅的渦振，常在低風速出現而影響舒適與疲勞；馳振是鈍形斷面在單一方向的自激振動，振幅隨風速無限增長；顫振是彎曲與扭轉耦合（或純扭轉）的自激振動，一旦超過臨界風速，氣動力持續輸入能量而發散；抖振則是紊流造成的隨機強迫振動，不會發散但控制強度與疲勞。風洞試驗要分別找出前三者的發生風速，並量測抖振的反應大小。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「渦振臨界風速 U_cr」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Wind causes four classes of dynamic problems on long-span decks: vortex shedding locks onto a structural frequency at particular speeds and causes limited-amplitude vortex-induced vibration, often at low speed and affecting comfort and fatigue; galloping is a single-direction self-excited motion of bluff sections whose amplitude grows without limit with speed; flutter is self-excited coupled bending–torsion or pure torsion that diverges beyond a critical speed as the airflow keeps feeding energy; buffeting is random forced vibration from turbulence that does not diverge but governs strength and fatigue. Wind-tunnel tests must find the onset speeds of the first three and measure buffeting response. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Vortex-shedding onset speed U_cr” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：渦振臨界風速 U_cr = f·D/St。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Vortex-shedding onset U_cr = f·D/St. With deck depth D = 4 m, vertical frequency f = 0.15 Hz and St = 0.10: U_cr = 0.15×4/0.10 = 6.0 m/s, a common wind speed, so vibration will occur frequently; a more streamlined section with St = 0.20 gives U_cr = 3.0 m/s but usually less energy.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要橋梁能承受最大風速的靜風壓，就不會因風而破壞。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If a bridge withstands the static pressure of the maximum wind, wind cannot destroy it." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「渦振臨界風速 U_cr」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Vortex-shedding onset speed U_cr”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 渦振、馳振、顫振與抖振：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Vortex shedding, galloping, flutter and buffeting: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「渦振臨界風速 U_cr」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Vortex-shedding onset speed U_cr” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：渦振臨界風速 U_cr = f·D/St。梁深 D = 4 m、豎向頻率 f = 0.15 Hz、St = 0.10：U_cr = 0.15×4/0.10 = 6.0 m/s，屬常見風速，振動會頻繁發生；若改為 St = 0.20 的較流線斷面，U_cr 降為 3.0 m/s，但能量通常較小。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Vortex-shedding onset U_cr = f·D/St. With deck depth D = 4 m, vertical frequency f = 0.15 Hz and St = 0.10: U_cr = 0.15×4/0.10 = 6.0 m/s, a common wind speed, so vibration will occur frequently; a more streamlined section with St = 0.20 gives U_cr = 3.0 m/s but usually less energy. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在節段模型試驗中由低至高逐級提高風速，記錄每一風速的豎向與扭轉振幅，畫出振幅—風速曲線，辨識渦振鎖定區、馳振或顫振的起始風速，並以不同攻角（例如 −3°、0°、+3°）重複，找出最不利情況。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: In section-model tests raise wind speed step by step, record vertical and torsional amplitude at each step and plot amplitude against speed to identify lock-in ranges and the onset of galloping or flutter, repeating at several angles of attack such as −3°, 0° and +3° to find the worst case.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 渦振、馳振、顫振與抖振：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Vortex shedding, galloping, flutter and buffeting: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「渦振臨界風速 U_cr」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Vortex-shedding onset speed U_cr” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在節段模型試驗中由低至高逐級提高風速，記錄每一風速的豎向與扭轉振幅，畫出振幅—風速曲線，辨識渦振鎖定區、馳振或顫振的起始風速，並以不同攻角（例如 −3°、0°、+3°）重複，找出最不利情況。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: In section-model tests raise wind speed step by step, record vertical and torsional amplitude at each step and plot amplitude against speed to identify lock-in ranges and the onset of galloping or flutter, repeating at several angles of attack such as −3°, 0° and +3° to find the worst case. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計審查要求風工程報告分別列出渦振、馳振、顫振的檢核結果與抖振反應，並說明每一項採用的允收準則；任何一項無法以計算確認時，必須以風洞試驗驗證。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Design review requires the wind report to list results for vortex shedding, galloping and flutter and the buffeting response separately, with the acceptance criterion for each; any item that cannot be confirmed by calculation must be verified by wind-tunnel test.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：1940 年 11 月 7 日，主跨約 853 m、以 8 呎深板梁為加勁梁的塔科馬海峽橋，在約 40 mph（64 km/h）的風中發生扭轉振動，振幅不斷增大直到吊索斷裂、橋面墜落；這不是靜力風壓過大，而是氣動自激振動。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: On 7 November 1940 the Tacoma Narrows Bridge, with a main span of about 853 m stiffened by 8 ft deep plate girders, twisted in a wind of about 40 mph (64 km/h) with growing amplitude until suspenders broke and the deck fell; the cause was aeroelastic self-excitation, not excessive static wind pressure. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 設計審查要求風工程報告分別列出渦振、馳振、顫振的檢核結果與抖振反應，並說明每一項採用的允收準則；任何一項無法以計算確認時，必須以風洞試驗驗證。

A bridge tested in a wind tunnel before completion will never have wind-vibration problems in service.
quiz.explanation: 在節段模型試驗中由低至高逐級提高風速，記錄每一風速的豎向與扭轉振幅，畫出振幅—風速曲線，辨識渦振鎖定區、馳振或顫振的起始風速，並以不同攻角（例如 −3°、0°、+3°）重複，找出最不利情況。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: In section-model tests raise wind speed step by step, record vertical and torsional amplitude at each step and plot amplitude against speed to identify lock-in ranges and the onset of galloping or flutter, repeating at several angles of attack such as −3°, 0° and +3° to find the worst case. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 渦振、馳振、顫振與抖振：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Vortex shedding, galloping, flutter and buffeting: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「渦振臨界風速 U_cr」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Vortex-shedding onset speed U_cr” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 1940 年 11 月 7 日，主跨約 853 m、以 8 呎深板梁為加勁梁的塔科馬海峽橋，在約 40 mph（64 km/h）的風中發生扭轉振動，振幅不斷增大直到吊索斷裂、橋面墜落；這不是靜力風壓過大，而是氣動自激振動。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: On 7 November 1940 the Tacoma Narrows Bridge, with a main span of about 853 m stiffened by 8 ft deep plate girders, twisted in a wind of about 40 mph (64 km/h) with growing amplitude until suspenders broke and the deck fell; the cause was aeroelastic self-excitation, not excessive static wind pressure. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：風洞試驗要分別找出前三者的發生風速，並量測抖振的反應大小。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Wind-tunnel tests must find the onset speeds of the first three and measure buffeting response.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要橋梁能承受最大風速的靜風壓，就不會因風而破壞。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If a bridge withstands the static pressure of the maximum wind, wind cannot destroy it." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「渦振、馳振、顫振與抖振」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Vortex shedding, galloping, flutter and buffeting" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
橋面斷面只影響外觀與交通，風洞試驗只需要看主梁本體。

optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
